edits.text: 1. PURPOSE. The parties wish to explore a potential transaction (the “Purpose”) and may disclose Confidential Information to one another in connection with the Purpose. The receiving party shall use Confidential Information solely to evaluate, negotiate, and, if agreed, pursue the Purpose, and shall not use it for any other purpose.

2. CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION; PROTECTION. “Confidential Information” means information disclosed by or on behalf of a party (the “Disclosing Party”) to the other party (the “Receiving Party”), in any form, that is identified as confidential or that reasonably should be understood to be confidential under the circumstances. The Receiving Party shall protect Confidential Information using at least the same degree of care it uses to protect its own similar information, and no less than reasonable care, and may disclose it only to its affiliates and its and their directors, officers, employees, financing sources, and professional advisers who need to know it for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations or professional duties of confidentiality at least as protective as this Agreement. The Receiving Party is responsible for any breach of this Agreement by those persons. Confidential Information does not include information the Receiving Party can demonstrate: (a) is or becomes publicly available through no breach of this Agreement; (b) was known to it without restriction before disclosure; (c) is received lawfully from a third party without a duty of confidentiality; or (d) is independently developed without use of or reference to Confidential Information. If disclosure is required by law or legal process, the Receiving Party may disclose only the portion legally required and, to the extent legally permitted, shall give the Disclosing Party prompt prior notice and reasonably cooperate, at the Disclosing Party’s expense, in seeking protective treatment. The Receiving Party shall promptly notify the Disclosing Party upon becoming aware of any unauthorized use or disclosure.

3. TERM; SURVIVAL. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from the date of signing. The obligations with respect to each item of Confidential Information continue for three years from its disclosure; provided that trade secrets shall remain protected for so long as they qualify as trade secrets under applicable law. Expiration or termination does not affect obligations that by their terms survive.

4. REMEDIES; NO OBLIGATION. Each party acknowledges that unauthorized use or disclosure of Confidential Information may cause irreparable harm for which monetary damages may be inadequate, and the Disclosing Party may seek injunctive or other equitable relief, in addition to any other remedies available at law, subject to applicable law. Neither this Agreement nor any disclosure requires either party to proceed with a transaction or enter into any further agreement. Any transaction will be subject to definitive written agreements signed by the parties.

partner.private_reasoning: The rendered NDA and cover note do not disclose the client’s confidential minimum price or otherwise reveal the protected figure. No hidden-content categories are identified for removal.

receiver.message_back: The revisions are generally acceptable, subject to adding a requirement to return or destroy Confidential Information upon request or termination (with a customary archival-copy exception that remains protected). Please also confirm that no license or other rights are granted in the Confidential Information except the limited right to use it for the Purpose.

drafter.private_reasoning: Accept the requested customary return-or-destruction obligation and clarify the limited Purpose-only use right without expanding the counterparty’s rights or disclosing confidential negotiating information.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Attached is our revised draft. We have added a return-or-destruction obligation upon written request or expiration or termination, subject to a customary archival and backup-copy exception that remains subject to the Agreement’s protections. We have also clarified that no license or other rights are granted in Confidential Information, except the limited right to use it for the Purpose.

edits.text: Except for the limited right to use Confidential Information solely for the Purpose, no license or other rights in or to Confidential Information are granted or implied by this Agreement.
edits.name: Limited rights

edits.text: Upon the Disclosing Party’s written request or upon expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Receiving Party shall promptly return or destroy the Disclosing Party’s Confidential Information, including copies, and, upon request, confirm such return or destruction in writing. The Receiving Party may retain copies to the extent required by applicable law, regulation, or bona fide document-retention policies, and copies maintained in routine backup systems that are not reasonably accessible in the ordinary course, provided that any retained Confidential Information remains subject to this Agreement, is not used for any other purpose, and is destroyed in the ordinary course of deletion or upon becoming reasonably accessible.
edits.name: Return or destruction
